payload.limitations: Single paired comparison with no population inference. The run uses the exact 2 October source/runtime/input package to isolate the previously observed drift mechanism; it predates the current Human head and the 3 October neutral-coordinate overlay. The overlay preserves equality-projected rigid poses, but this comparison is not a fresh current-main 10-second standing result, anatomical or physiological qualification, clinical assessment, or a controller pass. The progress stream exposes root-level accepted summaries, not the full q/v vector or per-route force decomposition. The control process exit status was not captured by the original malformed wrapper, although its raw stdout contains 200 accepted rows and a terminal-state record at step 1600; the follow-up labels this explicitly and does not claim a notebook-native control receipt. Only the treatment executes under this follow-up notebook. This remains a one-pair source-specific simulation diagnostic.
payload.uncertainty: Descriptive variation across declared pairs, not a confidence interval or population inference.
